headline: SWI Group, an Amsterdam-listed infrastructure company, has raised 800 million euros to expand its AI data-centre business, which includes the sites of Genesis Digital, a former bitcoin miner that Sam Bankman-Fried's firm Alameda once backed.
score_reason: Kept at 4: new on 12 Oct 2026 with an official announcement and a WSJ exclusive, read through three relays, but it is a mid-sized raise by a little-known company.
importance_line: FTX's creditors and SWI's new investors are affected first, since neither the trust nor SWI has disclosed what the estate received for dropping its claim, then the cloud companies that might rent the sites, but SWI has named no customers and, as The Tokenist notes, grid connections alone do not make a profitable AI business.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports in an exclusive, as relayed by Blockhead and The Crypto Times, that SWI Group, an Amsterdam-listed digital-infrastructure company, now controls Genesis Digital Assets, a former bitcoin miner in which Sam Bankman-Fried's trading firm Alameda Research once invested about $1.15 billion, and plans to offer its sites to the largest cloud-computing companies for AI work, its chief executive Max-Hervé George saying he has "zero interest" in mining bitcoin. SWI announced on 12 Oct 2026 an 800 million euro share issue to unnamed institutional investors at a 6.1 billion euro valuation, and FTX's bankruptcy trust dropped its $1.15 billion claim against Genesis Digital on 15 Jun 2026 with no terms disclosed.
notes: The WSJ original returned HTTP 401 and was not opened; the text was read on Blockhead (https://www.blockhead.co/2026/10/12/swi-group-raises-eur800m-to-turn-ftx-backed-bitcoin-miner-genesis-digital-into-ai-data-centres/), The Crypto Times and The Tokenist, which relay the WSJ interview and SWI's announcement, so the url is the WSJ original and the WSJ details are as relayed. CONFIRMED rests on SWI's own announcement as reported by three outlets; plans are the chief executive's. SWI's takeover of Genesis Digital dates from 15 Jun 2026, so only the raise and the exclusive are new.
